slices.focus: A family visit with Owen reveals that shorter, activity-first formats engage kids better than explanatory lead-ins.
slices.summary: Colleen brings prototype hose-nozzle handling cards to her sister's house and tests them with Owen. She discovers he engages far more with a timed clue challenge than with her careful educational introduction. This sparks a broader design insight: earn the explanation, don't lead with it. She commits to a three-beat structure (hook, clue round, story tie-in) and starts a simple observation notebook for Owen's reactions.
open_loops: Three-beat activity format needs full rewrite and further testing with additional kids
Involving Nina (librarian) for professional observation of children's flow
Prototype notebook format (hook/drop-off/re-engage) created but not yet populated
